Bonsai 2 27B: a 27B model that runs in 5.9 GB

We are releasing Bonsai 2 27B, a ternary-weight version of Qwen3.8 27B that occupies 5.9 GB on disk, more than 9x smaller than the full-precision checkpoint.

Each weight is stored as one of three values (-1, 0, +1) with an FP16 scale per group of 64, which works out to 1.76 bits per weight in practice.

On aggregate benchmarks the model retains 98.2% of the original score: 83.9 against 85.4 for the full-precision baseline.

Throughput reaches 143 tokens per second on a single RTX 5090, and 46.8 tokens per second on an M5 Max laptop.
